We need answer Chinese high school math multiple choice. Need select correct. Problem: planes alpha // beta, m subset alpha, n subset beta. Which conclusion necessarily true? Options:
A. m,n are parallel lines
B. m,n are skew lines (异面)
C. m,n are coplanar lines (共面直线)
D. m,n are non-intersecting lines (不相交直线)

We need reason. Two lines in parallel distinct planes? alpha // beta likely means parallel planes (disjoint, not coincident). m in alpha, n in beta. Lines lying in two distinct parallel planes. They cannot intersect because if intersect at point P, P in alpha and beta, planes intersect, contradiction (unless coincident; parallel planes distinct). So m,n are non-intersecting. They may be parallel (if directions parallel) or skew (if not parallel). In 3D, non-intersecting lines are either parallel or skew. Since in distinct parallel planes, cannot intersect. Thus D necessarily true.
Check C: coplanar? Two lines are coplanar iff parallel or intersect. They may be skew, e.g. alpha z=0, beta z=1, m x-axis in z=0, n line y-axis in z=1. They are skew not coplanar. So C not necessarily. A not necessarily. B not necessarily (could be parallel). D yes. Need final with 答案：D.

Need ensure no nuance: In Chinese geometry, 平面 α // 平面 β means parallel, no common point. m⊂α, n⊂β. Since any point of m in alpha, any point of n in beta, no intersection. So不相交. Yes.

content:
由于平面 \(\alpha \parallel \beta\)，两平面没有公共点。  
又因为 \(m \subset \alpha\)，\(n \subset \beta\)，所以直线 \(m\) 和 \(n\) 不可能相交。

它们可能是平行直线，也可能是异面直线，因此一定正确的是“不相交直线”。

答案：D
